name: Egg RNG Roller
summary: Egg randomizer machine with 14 configured egg templates, shop/inventory UI, player data, admin tools and optional developer-product cash packs.
install: Import EggRandomizerKit into Workspace in a separate test place. Its AutoInstall script installs a runtime copy on Play. For permanent installation, review and run require(workspace.EggRandomizerKit.Install)(). The installer moves children into the Roblox services named by their parent folders. Configure ReplicatedStorage.EggRandomizer.Config, your own product IDs and data-store names before integration; merge ProcessReceipt into your existing receipt handler rather than installing competing handlers.
limits: Preview release; persistence, purchases, multiplayer security and production economy are not certified. Developer-product IDs default to 0. Do not enable live purchases or production data stores merely to inspect this pack.
credit: Embedded README credits MarvinSmlchannel and says free to use in your own games; UI style credits Check-UI by TemporaryLooker22 (MIT). Original embedded notices remain intact.
verification: Limited Studio Play check in unpublished Place1: AutoInstall populated its destination services, the lever E prompt triggered black-silhouette shuffling and colored egg reveal, and inventory/cash-shop windows opened/closed. Passive currency tick was observed. DataStore explicitly reported unavailable in an unpublished place; developer-product lookup returned HTTP 404. No purchases, saving, admin actions or multiplayer certification. An admin-layout capture, if present, is preview-only, not proof of authorized admin behavior.
